requirement: A Joomla contract write holds at most 300 entities: a large FULL Apply lands in parts instead of failing whole

oracle.ref: PR #1328 (fix); fix evidence: Local stand, run j2 (14/10/2026): JA Voyara Joomla, FULL and FULL + design system, briefState failed with 'Split the revision into at most 300 entities' (1,833 lines on 348 entities); the site kept the template's words.
oracle.invariant: '1000 lines on 500 entities are written in parts of at most 300 entities, one entity never split across two' is ok: two writes, each at most 300 entities and 1500 lines, no entity in both, 1000 lines written. 'a part the language copies of its pictures take past 300 entities is written as two halves, never again whole' is ok: the seeder double refuses 280 pictured entities with one language copy each; every one of the 560 lines is written exactly once. '3200 lines are written in three parts of at most 1500, each read again before it is written' and 'a plan within one write is written once, as before' stay ok.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command
